description: A storage backend exposes a fixed set of file operations. A backend that does not implement a given operation must reject any attempt to use it with a normalized error rather than silently succeeding. The error is reported as a neutral category line, a stable domain error code, an HTTP-style status, and a human-readable detail that names both the attempted operation and the backend label. The request supplies the operation to probe and a label identifying the backend.
